summary: Verified all 4 targeted corrections on top of the base CET+Amendment-Diff feature (iteration_11). Tested against the two pre-seeded contracts: A=6a8c968f38ffe86939d74f51 (10->30 day amendment) and B=6a8ca06ec03ad07f41824cb3 (same 10->30 day amendment + case/order-reshuffled but identical recipient email set + manually lapsed 2026-07-01 deadline). Backend curl on /findings and /superseded-history confirmed: (a) only 1 notice_requirement finding remains on B (the unrelated stale 10-day one from primary2.pdf), the amendment-sourced 30-day duplicate was suppressed; (b) superseded history preserves the old renewal_notice with legacy recipient text and old 10-day notice. Frontend Playwright on mobile+desktop confirmed: (1) Amendment diff shows ONLY 'Notice period 10 days -> 30 days' and 'Deadline December 21, 2026 -> July 1, 2026' — NO 'Notice recipient' row; (2) Only one notice_requirement finding card is rendered (the unrelated stale one) — the amendment-duplicate 30-day one is suppressed; (3) Mobile identity header renders 'Beta LLC · 2 docs' with no inline Annual Value — annual value lives ONLY in the CET ledger row (shows 'Not provided'); (4) Mobile FindingCard for the lapsed renewal_notice shows NO fact-row grid (finding-notice-period / notice-anchor / notice-method / notice-recipient / next-renewal / money all resolve to 0 visible elements); it only shows type + rank (Risk), deadline hero (JUL 1), '54 days past deadline', factual lapsed consequence disclaimer, Confirm/Correct/Dismiss, and 'Review amendment changes' disclosure; (5) LAPSED explanation safety: expanding 'Show explanation details' on the mobile card renders 'Why it matters' (visible=1) but NO 'Suggested action' subsection (visible=0 across the entire page — both desktop and mobile gated by !lapsed). No Prepare-notice button is rendered anywhere for the lapsed finding, and no Deadline reminders block appears. Regression: CET ledger rows, amendment-diff evidence toggle, superseded-history endpoint, and Confirm/Correct/Dismiss controls all present and correct. All 4 corrections pass with zero defects.
critical_code_review_comments: AmendmentDiff.emailSetKey uses a permissive email regex that will match strings inside larger words (e.g. no lookaround). Fine for current inputs but consider tightening if free-text recipient strings ever include tokens like 'a.b+c@x.co.uk-suffix'.

_is_duplicate_notice_requirement compares only notice_days_min and day units. If the renewal_notice ever uses business-day basis while the notice_requirement is calendar-day (or vice versa), they would collide on integer value alone — worth guarding on notice_basis too (low risk today because current corpora don't mix).

context_for_next_testing_agent: The four narrow corrections in this iteration are green. FindingCard renders BOTH `hidden md:block` and `md:hidden` sibling divs inside ONE component instance AND ContractDetail duplicates the FindingCard list in a mobile wrapper, so every finding-related data-testid can match 2-4 DOM copies (only 1 visible per viewport). Always filter by is_visible() or use :visible in Playwright, never .first blindly. Login session cookie is set via /api/auth/login and reused; page navigations across scripts are separate sessions so re-login is required each script.
